# Trust-service fixtures

Recorded (synthetic) responses of the trust-anchor service per the verifier
contract `docs/trust-service-api.md`. Shapes verified against the service
source (`references/trust-anchor/repo`: routes/response/response.go,
trust/anchor.go). These fixtures ARE the contract for the verifier
extensions E1–E4 until they land upstream (WP-06 Decisions).

- `anchors-*.json` — generated by `testdata/gen` (reproducible; synthetic
  ECDSA P-256 CAs, never production PKI). `tlSequence` per anchor and the
  `type=` taxonomy are additive mock-contract fields (E3 rider).
  EUDI serviceType URIs are mock values pending CID (EU) 2025/2164 (E1).
- `snapshot.json`, `match-*.json` — hand-written, certificate-free.
- Snapshot ids are fixed synthetic 64-hex constants (snapV1/snapV2 in the
  golden tests). Regenerating changes certDer/fingerprints/subjects only.
